questions.question: What is polymorphism in Java?
options: The same reference type with different behaviors at runtime
explanations: Correct. Polymorphism allows a parent type to execute different versions of a method depending on the actual object.
It is not about creating multiple classes.

questions.question: What is the difference between overloading and overriding?
options: Overloading: same name, different parameters. Overriding: same signature in a subclass.
Overloading happens in subclasses, overriding in the same class
explanations: Correct. Overloading = same class, different parameters. Overriding = subclass, same signature.
It is the other way around: overloading in the same class, overriding in a subclass.

questions.question: Which operator verifies the actual type of an object before a downcast?
explanations: cast is not a verification operator.
Correct. instanceof returns true if the object is of the specified type.
typeof does not exist in Java.
getClass() returns the type but does not directly check against a given type.
